parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols bgp group internal type in.command: set protocols bgp group internal type internal

set protocols bgp group internal peer-as.command: set protocols bgp group internal peer-as 200

set protocols bgp group internal neighbo.command: set protocols bgp group internal neighbor 10.1.1.1
set protocols bgp group internal neighbo.explanation: 配置BGP内部组的邻居地址。

set protocols bgp group external type ex.command: set protocols bgp group external type external

set protocols bgp group external peer-as.command: set protocols bgp group external peer-as 100

set protocols bgp group external neighbo.command: set protocols bgp group external neighbor 10.20.2.1
set protocols bgp group external neighbo.explanation: 配置BGP外部组的邻居地址。

set protocols bgp group external neighbo.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] maximum-prefixes [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group external neighbo.command: set protocols bgp group external neighbor 10.20.2.1 maximum-prefixes 12000
set protocols bgp group external neighbo.explanation: 配置BGP外部组邻居的最大前缀数。

parameters.name: maximum-prefixes
parameters.explanation: 允许接收的最大前缀数。

set protocols bgp group external export.command: set protocols bgp group external export 10
set protocols bgp group external export.explanation: 配置BGP外部组导出的策略。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.20.2.2/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.2/24
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-options autonomous-system 20.explanation: 配置路由选项中的自治系统号。

set routing-options router-id 3.3.3.3.explanation: 配置路由选项中的路由器ID。

parameters.name: router-id
parameters.explanation: 路由器的ID，通常为一个IP地址。

set policy-options policy-statement 10 t.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] then metric [parameter3]
set policy-options policy-statement 10 t.command: set policy-options policy-statement 10 term 1 then metric 150
set policy-options policy-statement 10 t.explanation: 配置策略选项中的策略声明，设置特定术语的度量值。
